OET Pre-preparation
If your language level below medium it`s recommended to revise some grammer basics first
the following lists improve your basic skills

English Grammer
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SHwC9LNWLi1Vlvtccq0vBYf
Pronunciation
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SGQT8hrOMgtGc529XvZjVHx
Vocabulary
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SG65gk61Z5t-V35Sik_eEXp
Fluent English
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SEh_bF8W6AyZ7TIRhBXLZ_W
Advanced English
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SFdo5wFtK8BZEKCZ7knhy7V
==================================
Are you ready now to proceed to OET?
you can follow the below links

--( OET General )--
watch this video list 
to have a general overview about OET exam.

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SFYrDWO4UPeikZkltZ5ZjFj
=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

1 -(OET Listening)-

watch this video list 
to have a general overview about listening subtest.

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SGg8nTmS-ylMg0Mxxj_DDms

=====
If you are already aware of the exam and you just want to improve your listening skill:

follow this channel
GPs: Behind Closed Doors | Channel 

5

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sR1ZbQPQef4&list=PLN-GuLUgIqK2BPvLpQjFPPem07oqLWSUu

-It contains lots of physician-patient face to face clinical practice ---> useful for part A

=====
follow this channel

https://www.youtube.com/@JesseChappus

-It`s pure medical interviews ---> helpful for part B & C

-watch at least one podcast daily. You can use the CC button to read the script and assess your listening skills.

=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

2 -(OET Reading
)-

watch this video list to have a general overview about the reading subtest.
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SGDF3DDJ5H3nKasJqCMkaTH

=====
If you are already aware of the exam and you just want to improve your reading skill:

You have to read at least one medical article daily and record any new word you face.
This pracice will enhance your reading speed and focus better if you face complicated articles.

these sites are recommended by OET official site:

https://www.sciencedaily.com/

https://breakingnewsenglish.com/

https://theconversation.com/uk/health

https://www.nejm.org/

https://www.medscape.com/

https://medicinetoday.com.au/

=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

3 -(OET Writing)-

watch this video list to have a general overview about writing subtest.

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SGyLdKEqwZKeC_QKgbJhWBc

=====
read these tips

https://mega.nz/file/8BQGWKZZ#bmgDa8tHkk3ylpKo-Tw78p-EP8NJY5OYtpQB624-Ktc

Writing Score

https://mega.nz/file/NUoAwAIQ#vXmBzMOLkwTnWWMoDROjKRoKuFqEfuKUt-QIMTajT-Y

writing tips

https://mega.nz/file/IZ4SFIqB#swpvsNALMr57uoCV96Xmb0JQHFEivPAhpT_a0FW8IKE

=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

4 -(OET Speaking)-

watch this video list to have a general overview about speaking subtest.
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SEGmIx2S0cPWVIxqdtD3Wqe
=====
read these tips

Speaking Score

https://mega.nz/file/4VwTjBgQ#hwLMytTW-HkA6joqAXHBUracU3BsuuEscaeZSsUtuPg

https://mega.nz/file/sRxxlYxS#dkM_TN0Pcss7uUhOD-1joL6CEAcU-bFFQfz_E6nTJMk

https://mega.nz/file/UBZTlaqb#cZt8t74ZhxmUToYASvNUVEz9cU-MBM5Nt5T7yO-gwbI

Best of luck!
